measures: 3-month running mean of Nino-3.4 SST anomaly minus tropical-mean (20S-20N) anomaly, rescaled to ONI variance
why_relevant: Official NOAA index for identifying El Nino conditions since Feb 2026

measures: 3-month running mean of ERSST.v6 Nino-3.4 SST anomaly (centred 30-yr base periods)
why_relevant: Traditional ENSO index; matches prototype; used as sensitivity check

measures: Year whose monsoon seasons (JJA and JAS) fall inside an official El Nino episode (>= +0.5 C for >= 5 consecutive overlapping seasons)
why_relevant: Defines which monsoons count as El Nino monsoons for all El Nino-conditional hazard variables
notes: Episode rule is the official NOAA rule. The JJA+JAS monsoon-overlap rule is a PROPOSED project rule to be approved. RONI gives 17 years (drops 2009, adds 1976, 1977, 1994, 2004); ONI v6 gives 14 years. Prototype rule (mean AMJ-SON >= 0.5 and >= 3 positive seasons) is NOT an official definition.

measures: Total June-September rainfall averaged over the district area
why_relevant: Base quantity for all hazard indicators
notes: Area-weighted cell overlap recommended: small districts (Akola, Washim) contain only ~6 grid-cell centres.

measures: JJAS rainfall departure from the district's own long-term mean
why_relevant: IMD-style deficit measure (IMD deficient = -20% to -59%)
notes: Baseline period is a decision (e.g. 1971-2020, IMD's current normal period, or full 1951-2020).

measures: Standardized Precipitation Index of JJAS total (gamma fit)
why_relevant: Standard WMO drought index; comparable across wet and dry districts

measures: Mean JJAS departure across El Nino monsoon years
why_relevant: Average rainfall shortfall a district suffers when El Nino occurs
notes: Replaces prototype Mean_Monsoon_Deficit_pct (which used only 4 years).

measures: Share of El Nino monsoon years with JJAS departure <= -20%
why_relevant: How often El Nino produces a deficient monsoon in the district

measures: Correlation (or regression slope) between JJAS ENSO index and district JJAS SPI over 1950-2025
why_relevant: Directly measures the El Nino teleconnection strength per district - the 'El Nino' link in the title

measures: Literates / (population - population aged 0-6)
why_relevant: Education supports access to information, credit, relief and non-farm work

measures: (Main + marginal cultivators + agricultural labourers) / total workers
why_relevant: Livelihood dependence on rain-sensitive agriculture
source: Census 2011 PCA (MAIN_CL_P, MAIN_AL_P, MARG_CL_P, MARG_AL_P, TOT_WORK_P)

measures: Marginal workers / total workers
why_relevant: Workers with < 6 months work have little income buffer
notes: CORRECTION: prototype divided by total population (TOT_P), not by workers. Denominator must be decided and documented.

measures: Scheduled Caste population / total population
why_relevant: Proxy for historically disadvantaged groups
notes: SC and ST shares were strongly negatively correlated in prototype (r = -0.88); re-check at 33-36 districts.

measures: Scheduled Tribe population / total population
why_relevant: Tribal populations have lower asset base and higher food insecurity

measures: Rural population / total population
why_relevant: Share of population whose livelihood depends on local rainfall
source: Census 2011 PCA (TRU = Rural vs Total rows)

measures: Net area sown / total geographical area of villages
why_relevant: How much of the district's land is cropland exposed to rainfall failure
source: Census 2011 Village Directory (Net Area Sown, Total Geographical Area)

measures: Irrigated area / net area sown (Rainfed share = 100 - this)
why_relevant: Irrigation buffers crops against rainfall deficit; rainfed farming is the core of drought sensitivity (PPT slide 4)
notes: Use the column labelled 'Total Unirrigated Land Area' as IRRIGATED area - labels are swapped (verified in 43,661 of 43,665 villages). Resulting state figure ~19.6%.

measures: Wells/tube-well irrigated area / total irrigated area
why_relevant: Groundwater irrigation itself fails in multi-year droughts

measures: Number of holdings < 2 ha / total holdings
why_relevant: Smallholders have the least savings and credit to absorb a failed season
source: Agriculture Census 2010-11 Maharashtra State Report (Table 5 / Table 2)
availability: Direct (percentages in Table 5) / extracted from PDF
notes: Chandrapur 2010-11 row looks erroneous (near-copy of Gondia) - must be verified or flagged.

measures: District geometry keyed to censuscode 497-531
why_relevant: Needed to aggregate gridded rainfall and to map results
notes: Official alternative: Survey of India (pending manual download).

measures: Current 36 districts incl. Palghar; 357 sub-districts
why_relevant: Only needed if the 36-district option is chosen

measures: Declared talukas / all talukas per district, Kharif 2026
why_relevant: Independent observed outcome to test the index
notes: Not to be used in training.

measures: As above for 2018 and 2023
why_relevant: Additional observed drought outcomes

measures: IMD real-time district seasonal departure 1 Jun - 26 Sep 2026
why_relevant: Observed 2026 El Nino-season hazard for holdout comparison
source: IMD Hydromet district rainfall PDF snapshot
notes: Real-time provisional values; station-based, not the gridded product.

measures: e.g. improved drinking-water source, clean fuel, women's literacy
